_comment: Issue #1624: a spotted enemy stands in a cell whose CENTER the terrain overlay's own per-cell scan reads as outside the friendly's sight disc, even though the enemy's own position is inside it (283.55 wu from the friendly vs. its 300 wu foot sight radius; the enemy's 40 wu cell centers at 311.13 wu -- just past the boundary). No other unit is in play, so before the fix that cell is never covered by any per-cell scan and stays the opaque unexplored fill under a unit that visibly renders; after the fix the enemy's own cell is forced into both the currently-visible set and the persistent explored grid. Camera holds tight on that one cell so the boundary is legible.
